data.narrative:
The Red Metal Company is a Seed-stage climate & energy company led by Jackson Switzer that has raised $10M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public peer (LNZA) and eight private competitors in the Climate & Energy sector, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

A Stage-Progression methodology is applicable here, using the $10M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $25M. A Peer-Median approach is not viable; while nine same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier), falling below the required minimum of three comparable datapoints. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M. This range reflects the single applicable method and therefore carries material uncertainty. The primary risk to this estimate is the absence of granular peer comparables at identical or adjacent stage and valuation tier; the $25M median should be treated as illustrative pending either: (1) identification of tighter peer comparables, (2) progression toward Series A financing events that may establish market-clearing prices, or (3) revenue or operational milestones that enable alternative valuation anchors.
